understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid to complete each level by stepping onto all goal cells only when the carried piece exactly matched each goal’s required shape, color, and rotation. Completing all goals advances to the next level, and winning requires finishing all levels before running out of lives/turn budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (north/south/east/west) costs 1 stamina; when stamina hits 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum, and losing all lives ends the game (GAME_OVER). Walls block movement, and the state provides a list of blocked_directions that should never be chosen because they waste a turn with no position change. Special modifier tiles change the carried piece: shape changers cycle shape indices 0–5, color changers cycle colors in order orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation changers rotate the piece 90° clockwise (0°→90°→180°→270°→0°). A goal cell is only completable/activates when the piece’s shape, color, and rotation simultaneously match its requirements; then stepping onto it completes that goal.
